topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this. I come out to my driveway, expecting a smooth morning, ready to head off, and what do I find? Silence. My car, gone. Just a note with some nonsense about parking violations. I didn’t park anywhere! This is my driveway. The nerve of some people, thinking they can just take what’s mine, disrupt my plans. I’m supposed to be places, have things to do. Now I’m stuck here, wasting time trying to figure out how to fix this mess. They better hope I find a solution soon, or there’ll be trouble.
